layout: Meme is divided into two main panels. The top panel shows a pair of buttons with corresponding text on them. The bottom panel shows a character reacting.
character_position: The character is in the bottom panel, occupying roughly 40% of the frame, primarily on the left side.

text_style.color: Black text on a white background
text_style.position: Top panel, centered above each button

content_structure: Comparison format. The top panel presents a dilemma with two contrasting choices on buttons. The bottom panel shows the character's reaction to the dilemma.
description: The meme uses a common 'two buttons' dilemma format to highlight indecision or difficult choices, juxtaposed with a character showing anxiety or stress.
